title: Il y a (there is / there are)
summary: Il y a introduces what exists in a place. Use un/une/des before countable nouns. Negation often becomes il n’y a pas de…
full_explanation: Il y a introduces what exists in a place. Use un/une/des before countable nouns. Negation often becomes il n’y a pas de…

examples.french: Il n’y a pas de métro.
Dans la rue, il y a un café.
examples.english: There is a cafe on the street.

examples.french: Il y a un hôpital près d’ici.
examples.english: There is a hospital near here.

sections.heading: Traps
sections.body: Do not translate word-for-word from English every time. Keep French chunks whole. Check gender and articles when a noun is involved.
